status: source-informed extension; source values and layouts inspected before this specification

references_checked_before_launch.HPCS: Nature 2026 Fig. 2 and Supplementary Table 4 Mice; pinned dbetel tracing notebooks and 2020 repository tree
references_checked_before_launch.Tsutsui: Nature Communications 2026 Figs. 6, 8, 9 and Supplementary Data 2; DDBJ full SRA records
references_checked_before_launch.AP1: Lynch bioRxiv v2 Fig. 4I and actual HOPX workbook DC5; published July 2026 abstract; pooled multiome metadata
references_checked_before_launch.TP53: Morowitz bioRxiv v1 Fig. 5 and Supplementary Data Table 1; both cited GEO records currently private

hpcs.join: exact source alias prefix before underscore to Mice sheet Tag; library and driver must agree
hpcs.unit: named mouse; keep library, sex, reporter genotype, rounded harvest week and chase separate
hpcs.summaries: equal mouse mean and range of state fractions; inventory listed mice without retained traced cells
hpcs.inference: none: chase remains confounded with sequencing library; current reporter not recovered

ap1.endpoint: HOPX-positive fraction among GFP-labelled AT2-lineage cells; not completed functional AT1 fate
ap1.units: three mice per genotype; three fields per mouse and region; mouse IDs scoped within genotype
ap1.primary: sum positive and total counts within mouse-region; equal-mouse mean; genotype difference in each region and difference of within-mouse regional differences
ap1.sensitivity: equal-field fractions within mouse; all nine leave-one-mouse-per-genotype omissions
ap1.uncertainty: exploratory two-sided exhaustive permutation of six mouse regional differences into 3+3 groups; 20 allocations; conditional exchangeability assumption; minimum attainable two-sided p is 0.10
ap1.excluded: no field-level or cell-level inferential tests; no universal beneficial AP-1 inhibition claim

tsutsui.endpoints: all marker blocks and HiBiT in Figure 6; all gel and knockdown blocks in Figure 9
tsutsui.summary: means, sample SD, n, min/max; verify against cached workbook averages and SDs; descriptive condition ratios
tsutsui.missing: dash is missing, numeric zero is observed; no pseudocounts
tsutsui.replication: author-declared biologically independent culture experiments, one parental epithelial iPSC line; no assumed cross-panel pairing
tsutsui.units: qPCR adult-lung ratios for Figure 6 markers, HiBiT luminescence with unspecified absolute units, normalized contraction inhibition and relative expression for Figure 9
tsutsui.inference: no new tests using deterministic siCont=1 or normalized contraction controls=0/100
tsutsui.regulatory_genes: reconstruct 325 shared predicted motif-associated genes and supplied 126-gene RNA-upregulated subset; no enrichment test without universe; prediction not validated binding

tp53.analysis: audit selected DE lists, signs and frozen eight A1 markers; describe shared concordant and opposite changes
tp53.limits: selected significant gene sets; no unfiltered universe, counts or new p-values; difference in significance is not origin interaction; preprint not independent validation of Tsutsui

outputs: new tables/regulatory_fate and figures/regulatory_fate; preserve all earlier numerical outputs
